data.long_meaning: Ibrahimzai is a surname that means 'descendant of Ibrahim' (Abraham), a prophet in Islam. It is a common surname among Pashto-speaking people. The name Ibrahimzai carries the meaning “Descendant of Ibrahim” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibrahimzai usually hope their child will grow to embody descendant of ibrahim and live with faith, good character and purpose.
